title: SmartEvents!
description: This plugin helps with hosting events in your server!
body:
# 🎪 EventHelper **The Ultimate Minecraft Server Event & Minigame Manager** **EventHelper** is a powerful, all-in-one Paper plugin designed to give server owners and event hosts **absolute control** over their players, inventories, combat, and server mechanics! Whether you are hosting a 100-player Battle Royale, a custom SMP challenge, or a story-driven lore event, EventHelper provides the professional tools you need to run it flawlessly. --- # 🌟 Key Features **🎯 The "Affected" Roster System**

Never type out twenty player names again. Use `/affect` to easily build a roster of participants. Once players are "affected", almost every command in this plugin can target them simultaneously! * *Targeting Options:* Target specific players, `@e` (everyone), or `affected`.


**🎒 Interactive GUI Kit Editor**

Throw away your complex config files. EventHelper features a gorgeous, fully interactive Shulker Box GUI for creating kits! * Type `/kit` to open the Kit Manager. * **Drag & Drop:** Build kits using your own inventory. * **Dynamic Customization:** Rename kits via a hidden chat prompt and change their display colors on the fly! * **Instant Loadouts:** Use `/smartreplace with ` to instantly equip your players.


**🛡️ Custom Scaling Invincibility**

Need players to survive a massive drop or a boss fight without making them literally immortal? * `/invincible` applies custom damage scaling. Players take normal damage until 6 hearts, 50% less until 3 hearts, and 75% less until 1 heart. * **Totem Friendly:** The plugin intelligently recognizes if a player is holding a Totem of Undying, allowing them to take normal damage down to 3 hearts so the totem pops naturally!


**📖 Book & Quill Scripting System**

Minecraft chat is too small for big event rules and lore. EventHelper uses a custom Book & Quill engine! * Write your massive, multi-page script inside a standard Book and Quill. * Hold it and type `/setscript readbook ` to save it to the server. * Players simply type `/script` to open a beautiful, virtual book on their screen containing your rules and lore!


**⏪ Full Undo & Redo History**

Made a mistake? Accidentally teleported everyone into lava? Don't panic. * Every major action (teleporting, wiping items, changing borders, affecting players) is tracked. * Simply type `/undo` to instantly rewind time and revert the action, or `/redo` if you change your mind!


**🛑 Ultimate Crowd Control & Combat**

* **`/tpe[without ]`**: Instantly teleport your massive roster directly to you, with the option to exclude specific people. * **`/immobilize` & `/demobilize`**: Completely freeze players in their tracks. * **`/restrict worldborder`**: Snap a customized world border around your targets. * **`/smartfighting`**: A global toggle that completely disables PvP for any player currently in your event roster. * **`/smartchat`**: Mute global chat so your admins can speak without interruption.


**🧲 Advanced Inventory Manipulation**

* **`/smartsetinventory `**: Restrict player inventory sizes! If you set it to `9`, the plugin blocks out the rest of their inventory using Barrier Blocks, restricting them to only their hotbar. Excess items safely drop to the floor. * **`/delete all `**: Instantly wipe every copy of a specific item (like cobwebs or wind charges) from your players' inventories without clearing their armor or swords. * **`/smarteffect`**: Give potion effects that smartly re-apply themselves even if a player pops a Totem of Undying!


--- # ⚙️ Technical Details * **Server Type:** PaperMC (and forks like Purpur) * **Minecraft Version:** 1.21+ * **Dependencies:** None! Just drop it into your `plugins` folder. * **Client Mods Required:** None! Completely server-side. --- **Take the chaos out of hosting. Take control with EventHelper!**
